plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Adresse incomplète : renseignez la local: Incomplete address: fill in the locality, the street and the house number.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Adresse inconnue du service : cette rue: Address unknown to the service: this street does not belong to this locality.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Adresse valide, mais aucune collecte pub: Valid address, but no collection published for the next two months. Check the house number.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Le service a refusé la demande : vérifie: The service rejected the request: check the locality, the street and the house number.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Le service de collecte ne répond pas: The collection service is not answering
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Nouvelle lecture de l'adresse du service: Reading the service address again after a failure on:
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Renseignez la localité, la rue et le num: Fill in the locality, the street and the house number before testing.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Réponse illisible du service de collecte: Unreadable answer from the collection service.
plugins/hygeabe/core/class/hygeabe.class.Réponse inattendue du service de collect: Unexpected answer from the collection service:

plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Langue dans laquelle le service renvoie: Language in which the service returns waste type names ("Organic waste", "PMD"...). Commands already created keep their name, only the value changes.
plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Nombre de jours de collectes demandés à: Number of days of collections requested on each refresh. Beyond 60 days the calendar is usually not published yet.
plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Secondes avant d'abandonner un appel à l: Seconds before giving up on an API call. 10 is right in almost every case.

plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Aucune adresse pour le moment. Pour déma: No address yet. To get started:
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Chercher les localités de ce code postal: Search the localities of this postal code
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Cliquez sur « Ajouter une adresse » et d: Click "Add an address" and give it a name, for example "Home".
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Crée, pour chaque type de déchet rencont: Creates, for each waste type found in the calendar, its next collection date and the number of days left. Handy for a scenario watching a single bin.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Heure à partir de laquelle la collecte d: Hour from which today's collection is considered done and "Next collection" jumps to the following one. 0 keeps it displayed all day, 9 switches it after the truck has passed.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Indiquez le numéro de maison et enregist: Enter the house number and save: the commands are created and the calendar is fetched.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Le numéro de maison sert à départager le: The house number tells apart streets collected in two rounds. Without it, the calendar may be the one of the neighbour across the road.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Les collectes connues pour cette adresse: The collections known for this address, as the service publishes them. This calendar is read again on every refresh.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Saisissez le code postal, puis choisisse: Enter the postal code, then choose the locality offered.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Saisissez les premières lettres de la ru: Enter the first letters of the street, then pick it from the list.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Tapez le code postal puis cliquez sur la: Type the postal code then click the magnifier: one postal code may cover several localities.

plugins/hygeabe/desktop/js/hygeabe.js.Aucune collecte connue. Vérifiez l'adres: No known collection. Check the address, then click "Refresh now".
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/js/hygeabe.js.Plusieurs localités portent ce code post: Several localities share this postal code, choose yours.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/js/hygeabe.js.Saisissez les premières lettres de la ru: Enter the first letters of the street.

plugins/hygeabe/core/template/dashboard/.Affiche durée ou date de la valeur: Display duration or date of the value

plugins/hygeabe/core/template/mobile/cmd.Affiche durée ou date de la valeur: Display duration or date of the value
